I took over the team in February and I still don't know if I did it right. The previous lead left abruptly, no handoff, and I inherited a roadmap I didn't write and didn't fully agree with. I kept most of it anyway, partly out of respect for the work already in flight, partly because I didn't trust my own read on the situation yet.

The thing that actually helped wasn't a framework, it was just eating lunch with people one-on-one for the first month instead of scheduling formal check-ins. Half of what I learned that mattered came out sideways, in a comment about a totally unrelated bug, not in response to a direct question.

I'm still not sure the team trusts me the way they trusted the last person. Maybe that's not fixable in five months. Maybe it's not supposed to be. I keep going back and forth on whether pushing harder on the roadmap disagreement in March was the right call or just me being stubborn. Could go either way, honestly.
